name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.vl_le_of_norm
source: theorem vl_le_of_norm {x : ℤ_[l]} {B : ℕ} (h : (l : ℝ) ^ (-(B : ℤ)) ≤ ‖x‖) : vl l x ≤ B := by
have := normVal l 1 B x (fun _ => 1) h'
show: For x ∈ ℤℓ and a natural B, the real norm inequality ℓ^(−B) ≤ ‖x‖ implies vℓ(x) ≤ B.
strategy: Specialize the product version of the norm-to-valuation inequality to a single unit factor.

steps.claim: The lower bound ℓ^(−B) ≤ ‖x‖ is the one-factor product bound (ℓ^B)⁻¹ ‖1‖ ≤ ‖x‖, since the unit 1 has norm one. Its positive left side forces x to be nonzero.
steps.snippet:
have h' : ∏ _i : Fin 1, ((l : ℝ) ^ B)⁻¹ * ‖(1 : ℤ_[l])‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    simpa [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast] using h

steps.claim: Apply the product norm-to-valuation inequality with one factor equal to 1. Its valuation is zero, so vℓ(x) ≤ B + vℓ(1) = B, also when B = 0.
steps.snippet:
have := normVal l 1 B x (fun _ => 1) h'
  simpa [vl] using this

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
